style.shell: src/app.js: global state as one plain object, the route, the nav bar, the menu built on open; go(route) disposes the page and mounts the next, one delegated click listener on the app element
style.pages: one module per page exporting mount(a) -> { el, render, push, dispose }, written out from its description; state as plain objects in the closure (s page, t tab panel, m modal); nothing interpreted
style.rendering: one idempotent render() per page that writes every binding from the state (setText/setValue write only what differs); a handler changes the state and calls it, or a.changed() after a write to global state
style.lists: sync() in src/lib.js (the only generic helper, runtime): keyed by data-key, nodes kept across reorders
style.conditionals: created and removed after a comment anchor; tab panels and the modal built when selected or opened with fresh state
style.events: one delegated click, input and change listener per page on its <main>, switching on data-role; number inputs send only integers within range
style.time: one setInterval per mounted time-driven field, started when its page or tab panel is built, cleared when it is left
style.externalEvents: receive() in app.js; pagePush reaches only the page shown, through its push; lists replaced never mutated, message items copied
style.build: Vite, no framework plugin, no module-preload polyfill, hidden source maps

style.routing: in-app route signal in the app store; <Dynamic> over a table of page components in App resolves the page the route names; no router library
style.components: one component per page (src/pages/PN.jsx), with its tab panels and modal as components of their own in the same file; written from the description, nothing interpreted at runtime; the nav bar and the menu read a table of (id, title)
style.localState: a createStore created inside the page, tab panel and modal component, so it starts fresh on every mount; a panel or modal gets the page's store (and a setter) as props only if it reads (or writes) it; the modal remounts on every open (a counting signal and <Show keyed>)
style.globalState: one createStore per mount, plus the route and menu signals, shared through a context; read directly by the bindings that need a field
style.conditionals: <Switch>/<Match> for the active tab panel (at most four), <Show> for the modal, the menu, conditional sections and validation errors
style.time: setInterval in the component that owns the time-driven field, cleared with onCleanup
style.externalEvents: store.receive(msg); pagePush goes to the handler a mounted feed page subscribed (onCleanup unsubscribes); serverSet is a path set; snapshot is reconcile(structuredClone(global), { key: 'id' }); dispatched items are copied, never adopted
style.writes: path setters on the stores; click messages with several ops in batch; list items found by id
style.derived: plain expressions in the JSX, one fine-grained binding each
style.events: onClick/onInput (delegated), onChange for checkboxes and selects; number inputs send only integers within range
style.build: Vite + vite-plugin-solid, production defaults, hidden source maps

style.architecture: TEA with Browser.element: Main holds { route, menu, global, page }; page is a custom type with a constructor per page carrying that page's model, replaced by the new page's init on navigation (page-local state resets); Global is a module of its own
style.pages: one module per page (Model, Msg, init, update, view, subscriptions), written out from its description; one flat Msg for the page, its tabs and its modal; Go String for links
style.tabsAndModal: tab : Tab, a custom type holding the active panel's record (selecting builds its init); modal : Maybe Form; messages for an unmounted panel or modal are no-ops
style.globalState: update : Msg -> Global -> Model -> ( Model, Global ) when the page writes a global field, else Msg -> Model -> Model; Main forwards GotPage to the page shown and ignores it otherwise
style.routing: in-app state: a route field and a case on the Page custom type; links and the nav bar send Navigate / GotPage (Page.Go route); no URL
style.types: int Int, bool Bool, text and enum String (options as data in the view, a case for cycle), list a List of a type alias per list built by its positional constructor
style.derived: computed in view; an if is a let binding of the view function
style.conditionals: a view function per conditional section, called as Ui.when condition (viewSection …)
style.lists: Html.Keyed (Keyed.ul / Keyed.ol) with a viewXItem function per list; the app's children are Keyed.node keyed by shell, menu and route id
style.time: Time.every in the page's subscriptions (and the active tab's), forwarded by Main.subscriptions only for the page shown
style.externalEvents: one incoming port; Json.Decode into the app's messages (deepLink → Navigate, serverSet → SetX, notify → Notify, snapshot → Snapshot, pagePush → the feed page's Pushed)
style.events: onInput for text inputs and selects, onClick for buttons and checkboxes, Ui.onNumberInput (an integer in range, else no message) for number inputs
style.formatting: as elm-format 0.8.8 writes it where practical; elm.json lists only the dependencies the app imports
style.build: elm make --optimize, then uglify-js compress (pure_funcs) and mangle passes, as the Elm guide recommends

style.components: one module per page (bits, one reducer for the page, its tabs and its modal, initial local state, mount function with a static template whose bound elements are found by data-role, emptiness or a marker); tab panels and the modal are units of their own, mounted by a slot; nothing interpreted at runtime
style.lifetime: only the shell and the page shown (with its open tab and modal) are built; a slot mounts a unit when its key appears and, when it changes, runs the unit's stop (clears its interval, stops its nested slot) and removes its root; the 'All pages' menu is a slot too, built only while open
style.state: one immutable TEA model { route, menu, global, page } with the reference's shape; page-local state is replaced by the next page's initial state on navigation
style.updates: reducers are tables of arms by message tag; each arm returns the compile-time dirty bits of what it wrote and the new model; one dirty word per event (the six global fields are its low bits, the page's own fields follow), so a global write marks bits and the mounted page's static patch tests only its own
style.externalEvents: through the same reducer (send): navigate and deepLink replace the page, serverSet/notify/snapshot mark the global bits, pagePush reaches the arm of the page shown (dropped otherwise)
style.time: one setInterval per mounted time-driven field, started when its unit mounts and cleared by the unit's stop; a tick is a message to the page's reducer
style.routing: plain in-app state: a route field, buttons that send navigate, a slot that mounts the page
style.lists: keyed by id: changed rows patched, gone rows removed, misplaced nodes moved in one walk
style.conditionals: branches built once with the template, swapped for an empty comment while hidden, with their own nested patch
style.events: addEventListener on each element; the handler sends a constant message (or one carrying the control's value)
style.build: Vite with no framework plugin, production defaults, hidden source maps

style.track: prototype: no framework implements this strategy
style.components: one module per page (its tabs and modal inside, sharing its state); a unit is a markup string and a function over its elements (E[n]), built when shown and disposed when it leaves; the shell lives as long as the app
style.lifetime: up() builds a unit and gives it a list of disposers; down() runs them once: its nodes, its timers (every) and its entries in the reader groups outside it (reg: global fields, the page's fields)
style.routing: in-app state: a route number, the page built on go(); one delegated click listener for the nav bar, the menu and the pages' links
style.messages: erased for DOM events: each update arm is inlined into the action its control calls, which writes the unit's fields in place
style.updates: each action schedules the binding groups of the fields it writes (known at compile time): the unit's own, the page's, and for global fields the groups registered outside every unit (GR); one microtask flush
style.lists: page-local lists edit rows in place (add) and remove by replacing the array; global lists are replaced and their groups reconcile by id
style.externalEvents: receive(msg): serverSet and notify write the global field and schedule its readers; snapshot replaces the global state and schedules all readers; pagePush calls the arm of the page shown
style.build: Vite with no framework plugin, production defaults, hidden source maps

style.approach: compiled dirty checking with mounting components: a page is a widget with its own binding list; an event digests the list it came from plus the lists of the mounted components that read what it wrote; navigation ends every component but the shell
style.components: one function per page, written out in full from that page's description, with its tab panels and modal as functions inside it; calling one mounts it with fresh state; no shared factories, no data rows, no interpreter
style.state: plain mutable variables: locals of the page's, tab's or modal's function (so they start fresh on each mount and are gone with it), module variables for global fields
style.lifetime: a component is a binding list with its root node and its cleanups; ending it removes the node, empties the list, leaves every set it joined, clears its timer and drops its feed subscription; navigation ends every mounted component but the shell
style.globals: each global field some component reads has a Set of the binding lists that read it (a component joins when it mounts); a handler or external event that writes it digests that set; fields nobody reads have no set
style.templates: one static HTML string per page, tab panel and modal, in the function that mounts it (texts escaped at build time, no end tags at its end); nodes are found by their position in the template, once
style.routing: in-app state: a route variable, a nav bar of the first pages and a menu built when opened; every link, nav and menu button shares one handler that reads the target's data-key
style.time: one setInterval per mounted time-driven field, started when its component mounts and cleared when it ends
style.events: one delegated click and input listener on the app element that calls the target's handler
style.build: Vite production build, no plugin, hidden source maps

style.components: the shell, every page, every tab panel and every modal is a component instance (src/routed.js) with its model in a closure, its reducer (a jump table by message tag, one arm per message, written out from its kind and ops), its own static template and binding list; pages are factories in a table, tab panels and modals factories nested in their page's, the way a child component is written inside its parent
style.lifetime: the shell's patch calls the page slot with the route, the page's patch calls a slot with the tab and another with the modal flag: a new key destroys the child instance (unwatches the instances it reads, clears its timers, destroys its own slots) and removes its node, then makes the next; page, tab and modal state therefore start fresh each time, and only the shell and the page shown exist
style.globalState: one instance with no DOM; the shell and every mounted component that reads a global field watch it; writes are messages to it (a generic arm per operation, numbered in order of first use, after serverSet's four and Notify)
style.crossInstance: commands run before the reducer arm: a link sends the shell Go, a control that writes global state sends the global instance its message, a modal's confirm sends its page a Confirm message carrying the modal's values (the page closes the modal); reducers stay pure
style.time: a time-driven field is one setInterval started when its component is made and cleared by its destroy; its message is its own Tick
style.externalEvents: deepLink sends the shell Go; serverSet, notify send the global instance its messages and snapshot replaces its model; pagePush sends the page shown its Notify (and nothing when another page is shown)
style.lists: runtime keyed list by item.id: patch changed rows, one forward placement pass when order or membership changes; the global lists are bound the same way where a page shows them
style.dom: one static template per component (trailing end tags left out) inserted by insertAdjacentHTML at its place (a page at the end of the app, a panel after its tab bar, a modal at the end of its page), elements addressed by document order; one template per list row, cloned per new item; the menu is built when opened
style.conditionals: node in the template; while hidden, an empty text node holds its place
style.events: tags 0, 1, 2, … for the template's controls in document order (then each list row's), attached by position by the runtime's wire; messages are sent as send(tag, value); number inputs send valueAsNumber and the reducer takes integers within range only
style.build: Vite production build, no framework plugin, hidden source maps

style.architecture: The Elm Architecture: Tea.element; Main = { route, menu, global, page }, page a custom type with a constructor per page
style.components: one module per page (Model, init, Msg, update, view; subscriptions, notify where it needs them); tab panels and the modal are types and view functions of their page's module
style.routing: route in the model; Main.enter replaces `page` with the entered page's init (page state resets); a link is the page's Visit message
style.globalState: module Global (one record); a page that writes it returns Model × Global from update; views take it as an argument
style.lifetime: tab panel = Panel custom type built on ShowTabN; modal = Maybe, built on its open message; messages for what is gone are dropped
style.time: Interval.every (project platform layer: Sub.on over setInterval/clearInterval), declared by the page's subscriptions only while the page or its panel is in the model
style.conditional: if holes with an empty fragment
style.derived: expressions written out in the page's view (interpolation or markup holes)
style.helpers: Ui: intIn (integer within limits) and shown (number input text); Pages: the shell's table of pages
style.externalEvents: project platform layer Push.onPush (Sub.on over a window event), read with a schema declaration; pagePush handed to the page shown
style.inputs: controlled inputs; an int with a number input keeps its typed text beside its last valid number
style.ariaCurrent: the nav button is written twice in an if (aria-* has no removable form in beni's vocabulary)

style.routing: in-app route <let> in the root template; an <if>/<else if> chain with one branch per page (each given only the globals it uses) mounts the page the route names and destroys the one it leaves; no router; the nav bar and the menu read static tables of (id, title)
style.sharedHelpers: nextId is one module, src/list.js, imported by the pages and panels that add list items
style.components: one tag per page (src/tags/page-pN.marko), with its tab panels (page-pN-tK) and modal (page-pN-modal) as tags of their own; written from the description, nothing interpreted at runtime
style.localState: <let>s in the page, panel and modal tags, created when the tag mounts and gone when it is destroyed; the active tab's panel and the open modal are <if> branches, so they start fresh each time
style.globalState: <let>s in the root template, passed down as attributes (no context API): read-only as name=name, written as name:=name into a controllable <let/name:=input.name>; a page passes its panels and modal what they use the same way
style.numberInputs: the int-field tag: a controllable <let> plus a <let/pending> for an edit that is not a valid integer in range
style.time: <lifecycle> in the tag that owns the field: setInterval in onMount, clearInterval in onDestroy
style.externalEvents: app.marko <return>s a function (the root's tag variable) that assigns the root's <let>s; pagePush goes to the handler a mounted feed page set in the root's feeds Map from its <lifecycle> (onDestroy deletes it); dispatched items are copied, never adopted
style.writes: assignments in onClick handlers with immutable list updates; list items found by id
style.conditionals: <if> for conditional sections, validation errors, the menu, the active tab and the modal
style.lists: <for … by="id"> for keyed lists, <for> over the static tables of pages
style.events: handlers in markup (onClick, checkedChange); value:=, checked:= and <select value:=> for controlled inputs
style.build: Vite + @marko/vite (linked: false), production mode, client-only mount, hidden source maps

compression.js: minified by the framework's production build

attribution: source maps: node_modules → runtime; unmapped bundler output → tooling (counted with runtime); the adapter file → adapter (excluded); everything else → app. Brotli split: runtime = brotli(runtime+tooling); app = brotli(app JS) − runtime.
